'''Honka''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] frequenter of [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Before the war's start that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he visited the diner with his friend [[Sidewa]], a fellow Rodian, when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met with diner owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. 

==Biography==
[[File:Honka_and_Sidewa.png|thumb|right|300px|Honka visited Dex's Diner with Sidewa.]]
Honka was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who frequented [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district<ref name="Depth" /> of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] that started<ref name="SW2" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> He was often in the company of his<ref name="CSWE" /> Rodian<ref name="SW2" /> lady friend [[Sidewa]].<ref name="CSWE" /> 

Before the start of the Clone Wars<ref name="SW2" /> in 22 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Honka sat in a booth with Sidewa and a [[Human/Legends|Human]] inside the diner. While they visited the diner, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] arrived at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] to get diner owner [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster's]] help identifying a [[Mk I Saberdart/Legends|toxic dart]] he acquired during an [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. After Jettster and Kenobi sat down in the booth in front of him, Honka took a drink from his cup and talked with his companions.<ref name="SW2" />

==Personality and traits==
Honka, a friend of Sidewa,<ref name="CSWE" /> had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and yellow<ref name="SW2" /> head spines.<ref name="Aliens">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> His green skin was dark but was a lighter shade around his face.<ref name="SW2" /> "Honka" was a masculine Rodian name that translated to "vigorous, vital."<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Equipment==
While at the diner, Honka wore a high-necked brown [[Clothing/Legends|shirt]] with gray sleeves and green cuffs.<ref name="SW2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Honka first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="SW2" /> for which the Dex's Diner scenes were filmed at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], on [[August 7]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> The film released<ref name="Depth">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=Depth Commentary}}</ref> on [[May 16]], [[2002]],<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]''</ref> and the character was later identified on [[November 12]] of that year<ref name="DVD">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/news/2002/08/news20020801.html|text=Episode II On DVD & VHS}}</ref> with the Episode II [[Depth Commentary]] available on [[StarWars.com]] and accessed through the DVD-ROM home release of ''Attack of the Clones.''<ref name="Depth" /> "[[Star Wars Prequels Unseen!]]" a gallery in the [[Star Wars Insider 151|151st issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine, incorrectly stated the character was unnamed.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|151|Star Wars Prequels Unseen!|''Star Wars'' Prequels Unseen!|reprint=1}}</ref> The issue was published on [[July 22]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan Magazines">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/151|text=Star Wars Insider #151}}</ref>
